MRK.rationale: MRK scores -1.0 due to severe fundamental deterioration, expensive valuation, and multiple near-term headwinds. Q1 2026 net income collapsed to -$4.24B (eps -1.72) from +$5.08B a year earlier, driven by a $9.0B Cidara acquisition charge. While operating cash flow remained positive at $3.92B, the trailing PE of 31.4x sits at the absolute top of its 365-day range (10.8..31.4), mechanically inflated by the earnings collapse. Even on normalized adjusted EPS guidance of $5.10 for full-year 2026, the forward PE of ~22x is not cheap for a company facing a high-certainty Keytruda patent cliff in 2028, a broader LOE wave affecting nearly half of 2024 pharmaceutical revenue, and $2.5B in generic headwinds in 2026. Gardasil sales fell 39% in 2025. The balance sheet is deteriorating with equity down 11.5% to $45.93B and liabilities rising to $82.75B. Insider selling is concentrated (EVP sold 63.8% of holdings). The market has already partially digested the Q1 shock with only a -4.9% quarterly decline, leaving limited re-rating upside. Multiple downside catalysts exist: Terns acquisition closing in May 2026 with $5.8B charge, continued Gardasil erosion, and generic competition headwinds.
